purpose: Map numerical solvability as a function of fixed-plane head displacement and trial duration in the exact C0/C1 accepted-origin backend, so solver rejection and temporal rejection can be separated by response regime.
accepted_origin_heads: C0 -5.0 m in columns 1-49 and -4.5 m in column 50; C1 -1.0 m in columns 1-49 and -0.5 m in column 50; offsets added to each matching origin.
controls: Zero-offset equilibrium; exact nonzero offsets at prior MF6 trial heads where they fall in this set; tangent disabled throughout to isolate base transaction path.
frozen_gates: Use the existing C0/C1 numerical and mass/temporal policy without change. No floors substituted into normal transactions; no changed retries, tolerances, forcing, profile, grids or constitutive parameters.
measurements: committed state hash/revisions before and after
invariants: Every probe begins from fresh committed origin in a separate fixture initialization
Rejected trial must preserve state; accepted probe may advance only its disposable diagnostic fixture
No MODFLOW or production bootstrap semantics altered
No acceptance criterion based on equality of GWL and MODFLOW/interface head
interpretation: Characterization only. It cannot establish coupled-window qualification, production policy, a causal root cause, or a tolerance change.
completion_gate: Persist every matrix row including failures; report monotonicity/nonmonotonicity by head and duration; only then decide whether RESP01 can be resolved or must remain shared-authority blocker.
